Remote-home operation has specific ownership/control and normal-home-QTH restrictions; do not accept shared remote stations automatically.

world.WIA.official_summary: Applications use WIA online system with ADIF upload. Paper QSL, LoTW, eQSL AG accepted with prescribed verification; ordinarily one own DXCC entity, dates since 1946-01-01, direct same-band/mode terrestrial QSOs. Open/CW/Phone categories; digital voice is Phone. Per-award exceptions prevail. Non-Australian applicants need callsign proof and paid access.
world.WIA.proposed_workflow: Generate ADIF compatible with the WIA uploader and open the online status/application page. WIA's website verifies/imports LoTW and eQSL itself; this is not evidence of an externally documented application API.
world.WIA.implementation_notes: Scope by transmitter location and awards account. Preserve generic WIA rules but allow explicit award overrides, including Fifty on 50 pooling qualifying Australian mainland/territories.

world.NZART.sponsor: New Zealand Association of Radio Transmitters (NZART)
world.NZART.official_summary: Honor-system contact certification; QSL cards unnecessary. No Internet-linked or cross-band contacts; repeaters only when expressly allowed; satellite/EME radio-to-radio accepted. Email awards@nzart.org.nz with name, callsign, address and checking log; Excel preferred, PDF/scans accepted. Certificates normally emailed PDF; any charge confirmed by manager.
world.NZART.proposed_workflow: Generate a sponsor-specific checking XLSX/CSV/PDF and email draft. Record declaration acceptance separately from QSL confirmation. No public submission API located.
world.NZART.implementation_notes: Do not apply a paper-QSL gate to NZART. Distinguish actual operating-area awards from callsign-series awards. Closed branch validity and award-fixed district geography require historical reference records.

world.RAC.official_summary: Use individual official PDFs. Paper, LoTW, eQSL AG and QRZ confirmations accepted. Application certification requires two unrelated licensed amateurs; do not attach QSLs/screenshots unless requested. Complete the award form, then online application/payment. Own contacts ordinarily within one DXCC entity; proof needed for former callsigns. Repeaters excluded.
world.RAC.proposed_workflow: Populate the official PDF or equivalent checking log plus signature fields; open RAC online form. Never auto-sign witnesses. No public third-party award submission API located.
world.RAC.implementation_notes: Canadaward became multiband-basic in 2023; Trans-Canada was replaced by Canadian Century Club. Digital-voice confirmation is Phone, not data.

world.LABRE.proposed_workflow: Create ordered evidence-indexed log and email draft. WAB has a sponsor-advertised credit tool, but no documented external API found. Reconfirm tool integrity with LABRE before credentials or integration.

world.RCU.proposed_workflow: Export cxaward-style checking log and evidence inventory; prepare email draft. No public submission API found.

research.purpose: Entity chasing with a substantial multiband progression beyond a basic DXCC counter.
research.modes: Mixed, CW and Phone are in scope; digital-only certificates hidden by default. Phone is broader than SSB.
research.bands: Award-specific; 60 m excluded. Challenge uses 160/80/40/30/20/17/15/12/10/6 m.

research.fields: DXCC, QSO_DATE, BAND, MODE/SUBMODE, MY_DXCC, STATION_CALLSIGN; station/operator identity, control method, propagation, dated entity validity and sponsor credit records.
research.calculation: Build separate entity and entity×band sets per award account, mode variant and accepted evidence view. Never sum pre-aggregated logs across different home entities. Use dated sponsor exceptions and current/deleted status from versioned reference data.
research.submission: LoTW award workflow for its credits; Online DXCC or current application/record sheets for cards and a checker/HQ. Signed-log upload and DXCC-credit retrieval are documented integrations; no public final-claim API is established by this research.

open_questions: Translate the complete current rules, historical cross-mode exceptions and each band endorsement before certifying a production rule pack. Do not hard-code today's entity total. Existing generic DXCC implementation must be audited rather than replaced blindly.
